evals.prompt: Create a bug report issue for the authentication timeout problem described in auth.js
evals.expected_output: A properly structured bug issue created via gh api with appropriate type, title, and body
expectations: The issue type is set to Bug (using -f type parameter)
The issue body includes steps to reproduce, expected vs actual behavior
The gh api command is used to create the issue (not MCP tools)
The issue URL is reported back to the user
